title: The Surprise Ending to the Mar-a-Lago Documents Case

sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.zh: 探索太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com/subscribe 享受特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: As the Republican National Convention entered its second day,
sentences.zh: 随着共和党全国代表大会进入第二天，

sentences.en: Donald Trump and his allies absorbed the stunning new reality that the most formidable legal case against him had been thrown out by a federal judge.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普及其盟友接受了一个令人震惊的新现实：针对他最严峻的法律诉讼已被联邦法官驳回。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Alan Foyer on what it means that the classified documents case may now be dead.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事艾伦·福耶尔将探讨机密文件案可能就此终结意味着什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月17日，星期三。

sentences.en: So Alan, it's been a pretty relentless week of news about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，这一周关于唐纳德·特朗普的新闻真是接连不断。

sentences.en: An assassination attempt.
sentences.zh: 一次暗杀未遂。

sentences.en: Him announcing his vice presidential pick at the start of the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee on Monday night.
sentences.zh: 他在周一晚上的密尔沃基共和党全国代表大会开幕时宣布了他的副总统人选。

sentences.en: And amidst all of that, we got the news that really in any other week would have been the only thing anyone was talking about.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切之中，我们得到的消息，如果换作任何其他一周，本该是所有人唯一谈论的话题。

sentences.en: And that is what appears to be a major legal victory for Trump.
sentences.zh: 那就是特朗普似乎取得了一场重大的法律胜利。

sentences.en: The judge in the classified documents case threw out the case.
sentences.zh: 机密文件案的法官驳回了此案。

sentences.en: Remind us about this case.
sentences.zh: 请帮我们回顾一下这个案子。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: This is the case against Trump in which he stands accused of taking a trove of highly classified documents
sentences.zh: 这是针对特朗普的案件，他被指控在卸任后，

sentences.en: from the White House after he's left office down to his new post-presidential home in Mar-a-Lago, his club in Florida.
sentences.zh: 将一大批高度机密的文件从白宫带到了他位于佛罗里达州俱乐部海湖庄园的新住所。

sentences.en: And not only has he been accused of taking this stuff, these state secrets that really no longer belong to him because he's no longer president,
sentences.zh: 他不仅被指控带走了这些东西——这些因为他不再是总统而不再属于他的国家机密，

sentences.en: he then has been charged with willfully obstructing the government's repeated efforts over the course of months to get these documents back.
sentences.zh: 他还被控蓄意阻挠政府数月来多次索回这些文件的努力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the one investigative step in this case that everyone will surely remember is when the FBI executed a search warrant at Mar-a-Lago two summers ago
sentences.zh: 这个案子中每个人肯定都记得的一个调查步骤，是两年前的夏天，联邦调查局在海湖庄园执行了搜查令，

sentences.en: and they hauled away 45 boxes of stuff and found more than 100 classified documents in those boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们搬走了45箱东西，并在这些箱子里发现了100多份机密文件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The boxes stacked in the bathroom, the classified documents all over the house in Mar-a-Lago.
sentences.zh: 箱子堆在浴室里，机密文件散落在海湖庄园的各个角落。

sentences.en: And if I remember correctly, this was the most straightforward of all of the Trump cases, right?
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，这是所有特朗普案件中最直接的一起，对吧？

sentences.en: This was the one that was the most clear-cut against him.
sentences.zh: 这是针对他最明确的一起案件。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The charges were relatively simple.
sentences.zh: 指控相对简单。

sentences.en: And, you know, the evidence against him was very strong evidence for the government.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，政府掌握的针对他的证据非常有力。

sentences.en: Nonetheless, Trump's lawyers filed a barrage of motions attacking the validity of the charges.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，特朗普的律师还是提交了大量动议，攻击这些指控的有效性。

sentences.en: And these motions fell to the judge who was handling the case.
sentences.zh: 而这些动议都落到了负责此案的法官手中。

sentences.en: Her name is Eileen Cannon.
sentences.zh: 她的名字是艾琳·坎农。

sentences.en: And as you may recall, she herself was appointed by Trump in his final year in office.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得，她本人就是特朗普在任期最后一年任命的。

sentences.en: And she was assigned to this case really when she only had about three years of experience on the bench
sentences.zh: 而且她被指派负责此案时，在法官席上实际上只有大约三年的经验，

sentences.en: and had extremely limited experience in handling criminal trials in particular.
sentences.zh: 并且在处理刑事审判方面的经验极其有限。

sentences.en: And so, you know, she had to sort of deal with this flurry of motions that Trump's lawyers filed.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，她不得不处理特朗普律师提交的一连串动议。

sentences.en: And she gave a quite serious hearing to all of them.
sentences.zh: 她对所有这些动议都进行了相当认真的听证。

sentences.en: And in the end, lo and behold, one of those motions to dismiss the case finally worked.
sentences.zh: 最终，你瞧，其中一项驳回案件的动议终于奏效了。

sentences.en: So what sticks?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么起作用了？

sentences.en: What argument actually succeeded?
sentences.zh: 什么论点最终成功了？

sentences.en: It had to do with the way in which Jack Smith, the special counsel who filed the indictment against Trump, got his job, how he was appointed to his poSt.
sentences.zh: 这与杰克·史密斯——那位对特朗普提起诉讼的特别检察官——获得职位的方式有关，即他是如何被任命的。

sentences.en: And what Judge Cannon ultimately ruled was that Jack Smith, the way in which he was appointed as special counsel, violated the Constitution.
sentences.zh: 坎农法官最终裁定，杰克·史密斯被任命为特别检察官的方式违反了宪法。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's unpack that a little bit.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们来剖析一下。

sentences.en: How are special counsels typically appointed?
sentences.zh: 特别检察官通常是如何任命的？

sentences.en: I mean, how does it actually work?
sentences.zh: 我是说，这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: So a special counsel is simply a prosecutor with some level of independence from the Justice Department who is brought in to handle very sensitive political investigations.
sentences.zh: 特别检察官只是一位与司法部保持一定独立性的检察官，被引入处理极其敏感的政治调查。

sentences.en: They've had different names over time.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，他们有不同的称呼。

sentences.en: And they've also been appointed differently at different points in our history.
sentences.zh: 而且在历史的不同时期，他们的任命方式也不同。

sentences.en: So, for example, in the wake of Watergate, Congress passed a law called the Independent Counsel Act.
sentences.zh: 例如，在水门事件之后，国会通过了一项名为《独立检察官法》的法律。

sentences.en: And that gave prosecutors, special prosecutors, a great deal of leeway and latitude and freedom for how they wanted to conduct their investigations.
sentences.zh: 这赋予了检察官——特别检察官——在如何进行调查方面很大的余地、自由度和自主权。

sentences.en: Because we just had this massive political scandal.
sentences.zh: 因为我们刚刚经历了那场巨大的政治丑闻。

sentences.en: And the thought was, we need to give prosecutors who are looking at official corruption a lot of independence.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，我们需要给予调查官方腐败的检察官很大的独立性。

sentences.en: You want them not to be under the thumb of the political leaders they're supposed to be actually investigating.
sentences.zh: 你希望他们不要受到他们本应调查的政治领导人的掣肘。

sentences.en: Precisely.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: So that way of doing business lasted really from 1978 to 1999.
sentences.zh: 所以这种运作方式实际上从1978年一直持续到1999年。

sentences.en: And in 1999, there was a sea change in how special prosecutors got their jobs.
sentences.zh: 而在1999年，特别检察官获得职位的方式发生了翻天覆地的变化。

sentences.en: This happened in the wake of another political scandal, the Whitewater Affair, if you remember.
sentences.zh: 这发生在另一场政治丑闻——白水事件之后，如果你还记得的话。

sentences.en: That was the event that kind of consumed the Clinton White House.
sentences.zh: 那是某种程度上吞噬了克林顿白宫的事件。

sentences.en: You know, it was an investigation by the special prosecutor Ken Starr.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那是特别检察官肯·斯塔尔进行的调查。

sentences.en: It started as this real estate deal, and it eventually metastasized, of course, into a full-blown presidential sex scandal.
sentences.zh: 它始于一笔房地产交易，当然，最终演变成了一场全面的总统性丑闻。

sentences.en: And it was at that point that there was kind of a consensus in Washington that special prosecutors maybe had too much power.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，华盛顿达成了一种共识，即特别检察官的权力可能太大了。

sentences.en: And the idea was, let's move the framework and bring special prosecutors inside the Justice Department so that there was a little more accountability.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，改变框架，将特别检察官纳入司法部内部，以便有更多的问责制。

sentences.en: And what happened was the Independent Counsel Act was allowed to expire.
sentences.zh: 结果就是《独立检察官法》被允许过期失效。

sentences.en: And in place of that law that was passed by Congress, special prosecutors were given their jobs by internal Justice Department regulations.
sentences.zh: 取而代之的是，特别检察官的职位由司法部内部规章来授予。

sentences.en: And so you move from a law governing the way special counsels were appointed and operated to internal Justice Department regulations doing that job.
sentences.zh: 所以，你从由法律管辖特别检察官的任命和运作，转变为由司法部内部规章来完成这项工作。

sentences.en: They wanted to strike a balance between giving special prosecutors enough independence that they could successfully resist pressure from the outside on their work,
sentences.zh: 他们希望在给予特别检察官足够的独立性以使其能够成功抵御外界对其工作的压力，

sentences.en: but not so much independence that they might run amok and abuse their powers.
sentences.zh: 与不给予过多的独立性以防他们胡作非为、滥用职权之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: And there was, you know, lists and lists and lists of rules and regulations about how they could operate.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有数不清的关于他们如何运作的规则和条例。

sentences.en: They didn't have to report on their day-to-day activities to the attorney general.
sentences.zh: 他们不必向司法部长报告他们的日常活动。

sentences.en: The attorney general had the right to fire them for good cause, right?
sentences.zh: 司法部长有权以正当理由解雇他们，对吧？

sentences.en: They had to obey all the Justice Department rules.
sentences.zh: 他们必须遵守所有司法部的规定。

sentences.en: And so there was an attempt to put the attorney general on the hook for what the special counsel was doing,
sentences.zh: 因此，人们试图让司法部长对特别检察官的行为负责，

sentences.en: but still give the special counsel enough leeway not to feel pressure from essentially their bosses.
sentences.zh: 但仍然给予特别检察官足够的余地，让他们不会感到来自其“老板”的压力。

sentences.en: So in a way, it was a kind of Goldilocks solution, right?
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，这是一种“金发姑娘”式的解决方案，对吧？

sentences.en: The prosecutor should have some independence, but not so much that they have no accountability.
sentences.zh: 检察官应该有一定的独立性，但不能多到完全没有问责制。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: It was absolutely independence versus accountability, a balancing act.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是独立性与问责制之间的平衡，一种平衡行为。

sentences.en: So then how did Cannon's ruling change all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么坎农的裁决是如何改变这一切的呢？

sentences.en: So Judge Cannon took a wrecking ball to this way of doing business by saying that Justice Department regulations alone
sentences.zh: 坎农法官通过宣称仅凭司法部规章，

sentences.en: aren't enough under the Constitution to appoint or govern a special counsel.
sentences.zh: 在宪法下不足以任命或管辖特别检察官，从而彻底摧毁了这种运作方式。

sentences.en: There has to be an actual law passed by Congress, as in the old post-Watergate days,
sentences.zh: 必须有国会通过的实际法律，就像水门事件后的旧时代那样，

sentences.en: or a special counsel has to get their job just like any other high-ranking, say, cabinet official.
sentences.zh: 或者特别检察官必须像任何其他高级官员（比如内阁成员）一样获得职位。

sentences.en: They have to be nominated by the president and confirmed by the Senate.
sentences.zh: 他们必须由总统提名并经参议院确认。

sentences.en: And so she said neither of those options, A or B, apply to Jack Smith.
sentences.zh: 所以她说A或B这两种选择都不适用于杰克·史密斯。

sentences.en: And so this just flew in the face of 25 years of sort of practice, procedural practice of how the Justice Department operates.
sentences.zh: 这简直公然违背了25年来司法部运作的惯例和程序实践。

sentences.en: And it flew in the face of many, many court decisions reaching back to Watergate that have upheld the legality of this mode of doing business.
sentences.zh: 这也违背了许多追溯到水门事件的法院判决，这些判决都支持了这种运作模式的合法性。

sentences.en: And what do we know about why Judge Cannon would make this pretty expansive ruling?
sentences.zh: 关于坎农法官为何会做出这一相当广泛的裁决，我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: I mean, given the fact that it departs from years of precedent about how special prosecutors have been appointed.
sentences.zh: 我是说，考虑到它背离了多年来关于特别检察官如何任命的先例。

sentences.en: Look, there's no way of knowing what Judge Cannon was thinking.
sentences.zh: 听着，没法知道坎农法官在想什么。

sentences.en: The reasons behind judicial decision-making is basically opaque.
sentences.zh: 司法决策背后的原因基本上是不透明的。

sentences.en: That said, there have been a couple of clues along the way.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，沿途还是有一些线索。

sentences.en: So Judge Cannon decided last month to hold two days of hearings on this very subject, which was itself a bit unusual because there was so much court precedent already in place
sentences.zh: 坎农法官上个月决定就此主题举行两天的听证会，这本身就有点不寻常，因为已经有太多的法院先例存在，

sentences.en: that she didn't really have to hold a hearing.
sentences.zh: 她其实不必举行听证会。

sentences.en: She could have just read the other cases.
sentences.zh: 她本可以只阅读其他案件的判决。

sentences.en: There's plenty of information out there and made her decision.
sentences.zh: 外面有大量信息，她本可以做出决定。

sentences.en: That's not what she did.
sentences.zh: 但她没有这样做。

sentences.en: And so it really seemed to be a signal that she was taking this issue very seriously.
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎确实是一个信号，表明她非常认真地对待这个问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, there was another interesting development shortly after she held those hearings.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在她举行听证会后不久，还有另一个有趣的进展。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And that was, you'll recall that the Supreme Court granted Trump a broad version of immunity from criminal prosecution.
sentences.zh: 那就是，你会记得最高法院授予了特朗普广泛的刑事起诉豁免权。

sentences.en: The blockbuster case in this most recent term.
sentences.zh: 这是最近这一任期内轰动一时的案件。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, as part of that opinion, Clarence Thomas issued a very unusual concurrence.
sentences.zh: 作为该意见的一部分，克拉伦斯·托马斯发表了一份非常不寻常的协同意见。

sentences.en: And in this concurrence, he essentially went out of his way to express doubts about Jack Smith's appointment,
sentences.zh: 在这份协同意见中，他基本上特意表达了对杰克·史密斯任命的怀疑，

sentences.en: even though that issue had no relevance to the larger question that the court was deciding on immunity.
sentences.zh: 尽管该问题与法院正在裁决的关于豁免权的更大问题毫无关联。

sentences.en: The lawyers in that case never raised the question of Jack Smith's appointment at all.
sentences.zh: 该案的律师从未提出过杰克·史密斯任命的问题。

sentences.en: He just sort of took a tangent and wrote a nine-page opinion that sounded a lot like what Judge Cannon ultimately ended up writing.
sentences.zh: 他只是偏离了主题，写了一份九页的意见书，听起来很像坎农法官最终写出的内容。

sentences.en: And so it was kind of widely read as some sort of encouragement to Judge Cannon.
sentences.zh: 所以这被广泛解读为对坎农法官的一种鼓励。

sentences.en: Because her opinion cited Justice Thomas' brief concurrence several times.
sentences.zh: 因为她的意见书多次引用了托马斯大法官简短的协同意见。

sentences.en: And the legal reasoning was very close to the reasoning that Thomas offered for why Jack Smith's appointment was unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 其法律推理与托马斯提出的关于杰克·史密斯的任命为何违宪的推理非常接近。

sentences.en: And look, there has been a separate but related conversation about Judge Cannon from the moment that she was assigned the classified documents case,
sentences.zh: 而且，从坎农法官被指派负责机密文件案的那一刻起，就一直存在着关于她的独立但相关的讨论，

sentences.en: which is, you know, she has made so many unusual decisions,
sentences.zh: 那就是，你知道，她做出了太多不寻常的决定，

sentences.en: decisions that are sort of outside the norm along the way that legal scholars who have been watching this case have been trying to figure out,
sentences.zh: 这些决定在某种程度上超出了常规，以至于一直关注此案的法律学者们一直在试图弄清楚，

sentences.en: does she have some sort of bias in favor of Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 她是否对特朗普有某种偏见，对吧？

sentences.en: And honestly,
sentences.zh: 老实说，

sentences.en: this most recent decision has just sort of increased the volume and intensity of that conversation because the ruling not only dismissed in their entirety the charges that Trump was facing in this case,
sentences.zh: 最近的这一决定只是增加了这种讨论的音量和强度，因为该裁决不仅完全驳回了特朗普在此案中面临的指控，

sentences.en: the decision was handed down at a hugely consequential political moment for Trump,
sentences.zh: 而且该决定是在对特朗普而言极其重要的政治时刻做出的，

sentences.en: which was, of course, on the first day of the Republican National Convention where he was going to be formally nominated as the Republican's presidential nominee.
sentences.zh: 当然，那是在共和党全国代表大会的第一天，他将在会上被正式提名为共和党的总统候选人。

sentences.en: Judge Cannon handed Trump a huge legal victory at a giant political moment.
sentences.zh: 坎农法官在巨大的政治时刻给了特朗普一场巨大的法律胜利。

sentences.en: And it's raised all kinds of questions, not only about this case in particular, but about what all cases involving special prosecutors might look like moving forward.
sentences.zh: 这引发了各种各样的问题，不仅是关于这个案子，还有关于未来所有涉及特别检察官的案件可能会是什么样子。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的拼图游戏《Connections》。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 开始游戏吧。

sentences.en: OK, so, Alan, you just said that there are implications for this case and for future cases.
sentences.zh: 好的，艾伦，你刚才说这对本案和未来的案件都有影响。

sentences.en: But let's start with this case.
sentences.zh: 但让我们先从这个案子说起。

sentences.en: What happens next?
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Jack Smith has promised to appeal Judge Cannon's decision.
sentences.zh: 杰克·史密斯已承诺对坎农法官的决定提出上诉。

sentences.en: And so what he will do is he will take the case up to the appeals court that sits over her, which is the 11th Circuit Court of Appeals in Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 所以他会做的是将案件上诉到她之上的上诉法院，即位于亚特兰大的第11巡回上诉法院。

sentences.en: In theory, it's also possible that Jack Smith could try to get Judge Cannon removed from the case.
sentences.zh: 理论上，杰克·史密斯也有可能试图让坎农法官退出此案。

sentences.en: That would also involve the 11th Circuit.
sentences.zh: 这也将涉及第11巡回法院。

sentences.en: But the point is, regardless of what the 11th Circuit ends up doing on any of these issues,
sentences.zh: 但重点是，无论第十一巡回法院最终如何处理这些问题，

sentences.en: all of this is very likely to end up at the Supreme Court in front of Justice Thomas and his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 这一切很可能会最终上诉到最高法院，呈现在托马斯大法官及其同事面前。

sentences.en: And that will be the moment we'll get a much clearer picture of the future of special counsels.
sentences.zh: 到那时，我们将能更清晰地看清特别检察官制度的未来。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, it sounds like the case is dead.
sentences.zh: 但在此期间，听起来这个案子已经没戏了。

sentences.en: The case against Trump is dead.
sentences.zh: 针对特朗普的诉讼已经终结。

sentences.en: There is no case against Trump anymore.
sentences.zh: 针对特朗普的诉讼已不复存在。

sentences.en: And, Alan, does this affect the other Jack Smith case, you know, the one about Trump's involvement in January 6th?
sentences.zh: 艾伦，这会影响杰克·史密斯负责的另一个案子吗？就是关于特朗普参与1月6日国会山骚乱的那起案件？

sentences.en: Because it calls into question, of course, Jack Smith's ability to bring any case.
sentences.zh: 因为这当然会让人质疑杰克·史密斯提起任何诉讼的能力。

sentences.en: It certainly could.
sentences.zh: 当然有可能。

sentences.en: Eventually, Trump's lawyers in that case have not raised this issue about Jack Smith's appointment.
sentences.zh: 目前，特朗普在该案中的律师尚未提出关于杰克·史密斯任命合法性的问题。

sentences.en: They might do so.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会这样做。

sentences.en: Don't forget, that case has been on hold for seven months while the courts up to the Supreme Court were deciding the immunity issue.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，那起案件已经搁置了七个月，当时法院一直在审理直至最高法院，以裁定豁免权问题。

sentences.en: And it's about to become unfrozen in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 而且它即将在未来几周内解冻。

sentences.en: So there will be a flurry of activity in that case.
sentences.zh: 所以那起案件将会出现一连串的活动。

sentences.en: And one of the things that might happen is the lawyers in the Washington case, the January 6th case, could say, hey,
sentences.zh: 其中可能会发生的一件事是，华盛顿案（即1月6日案）的律师可能会说，嘿，

sentences.en: if Jack Smith has been found to be invalid in the case in Florida, why not here too?
sentences.zh: 如果杰克·史密斯在佛罗里达州的案件中被裁定为任命无效，那为什么在这里不行呢？

sentences.en: In the meantime,
sentences.zh: 在此期间，

sentences.en: we're starting to see the first signs that Judge Cannon's ruling is being used by defense lawyers in other cases involving other special counsels trying to use it to their advantage.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到初步迹象，坎农法官的裁决正被其他案件的辩护律师所利用，他们试图利用涉及其他特别检察官的案件来为自己谋利。

sentences.en: So, for example, hours after Judge Cannon's decision came down, lawyers out in Las Vegas in a totally separate special counsel case said, hey,
sentences.zh: 例如，在坎农法官的裁决下达几小时后，拉斯维加斯一起完全独立的特别检察官案件的律师就说，嘿，

sentences.en: our special counsel should be invalidated too.
sentences.zh: 我们的特别检察官也应该被撤职。

sentences.en: Because look what Judge Cannon said.
sentences.zh: 因为看看坎农法官是怎么说的。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: You know, now there aren't a ton of cases across the country that involve special counsels.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在全国范围内涉及特别检察官的案件并不多。

sentences.en: There are some.
sentences.zh: 有一些。

sentences.en: There's another case that involves Hunter Biden.
sentences.zh: 还有一起涉及亨特·拜登的案件。

sentences.en: It's out in California.
sentences.zh: 在加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: It's a tax case.
sentences.zh: 那是一起税务案件。

sentences.en: And the lawyers in that case have already tried to claim that the special counsel, David Weiss, in that instance, was invalidly appointed.
sentences.zh: 该案的律师已经试图声称，在该案中，特别检察官大卫·韦斯的任命是无效的。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Will they use Judge Cannon's ruling to seek to reopen that question?
sentences.zh: 他们会利用坎农法官的裁决来寻求重新审视这个问题吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Remains to be seen.
sentences.zh: 拭目以待。

sentences.en: So there are some trickle-down effects here already.
sentences.zh: 所以这里已经产生了一些连锁反应。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, small as they may be, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，尽管规模可能很小，但确实如此。

sentences.en: And all of this is just sort of percolating right now until, as we discussed, it sort of makes its way up the food chain to the Supreme Court, which will really,
sentences.zh: 这一切目前都在酝酿之中，直到正如我们讨论的那样，它会沿着司法层级向上推进到最高法院，届时，

sentences.en: should it be so inclined, make some changes.
sentences.zh: 如果最高法院有意愿的话，它会做出一些改变。

sentences.en: Okay, so say this case were to stand, what would that mean for that balance you were talking about before in terms of, you know, prosecutors and their independence?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么假设这个裁决维持原判，这对你之前谈到的关于检察官及其独立性的平衡意味着什么？

sentences.en: Independence on the one hand versus accountability to public officials on the other.
sentences.zh: 一方面是独立性，另一方面是对公职人员的问责制。

sentences.en: Clearly, Judge Cannon has come down on the side that special prosecutors need to be more constrained, that there aren't enough regulations on them.
sentences.zh: 显然，坎农法官站在了特别检察官需要受到更多约束、对他们的监管不足这一边。

sentences.en: So on the spectrum of independence and accountability, she wants much more accountability and much less independence.
sentences.zh: 因此，在独立性和问责制的范围内，她想要更多的问责制和更少的独立性。

sentences.en: And that issue, once it gets played out through the courts,
sentences.zh: 而这个问题，一旦在法院中得到解决，

sentences.en: could have important ramifications in a world in which Donald Trump retakes the White House and carries through on his promises to weaponize the Justice Department against his enemies.
sentences.zh: 可能会在唐纳德·特朗普重返白宫并兑现他将司法部武器化以对付政敌的承诺的世界中，产生重要的影响。

sentences.en: Who will be there should special counsels be stripped of the independence that they have traditionally have to investigate the kinds of abuses of prosecutorial power that Trump is contemplating,
sentences.zh: 如果特别检察官被剥夺了他们传统上拥有的独立性，无法调查特朗普正在考虑的、

sentences.en: that Trump has promised to do?
sentences.zh: 特朗普承诺要做的那些滥用检察权的行为，谁来负责呢？

sentences.en: And so at the moment that this country might most need to look to independent prosecutors to hold powerful political figures accountable,
sentences.zh: 因此，在这个国家最需要依靠独立检察官来追究有权势的政治人物责任的时刻，

sentences.en: it's conceivable that their powers of independence might be constrained.
sentences.zh: 他们的独立权力可能会受到限制，这是可以想象的。

sentences.en: So in the longer term, this ruling really could have some pretty far-reaching consequences.
sentences.zh: 所以从长远来看，这项裁决确实可能会产生一些相当深远的影响。

sentences.en: I mean, depending on how it moves through the courts and on what happens in November.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这取决于它如何在法院中推进，以及十一月会发生什么。

sentences.en: And in the immediate term, I have to imagine that the political implications are going to be pretty profound, too.
sentences.zh: 而在短期内，我不得不认为其政治影响也将相当深远。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Judge Cannon's decision didn't only just get rid of this case for Trump.
sentences.zh: 坎农法官的裁决不仅为特朗普摆脱了这起案件。

sentences.en: What it really did is it bolstered a narrative that he has been pushing from the very beginning of all of these cases, which is that they were lawless,
sentences.zh: 它真正做到的是，它强化了特朗普从所有这些案件一开始就一直在推销的叙事，即这些案件是无法无天的，

sentences.en: brought by a prosecutor who shouldn't have been there in the first place,
sentences.zh: 是由一位本不该出现在那里的检察官提起的，

sentences.en: and that they were unconstitutional, and Trump can now point to a ruling by a federal judge that essentially says,
sentences.zh: 而且它们是违宪的。特朗普现在可以指着一位联邦法官的裁决，该裁决本质上说，

sentences.en: this guy, Jack Smith, who has brought these two federal cases against me, got his job improperly and should never have been in place to begin with.
sentences.zh: 这个对我提起这两起联邦诉讼的家伙，杰克·史密斯，他的职位获取是不正当的，本来就不应该存在。

sentences.en: So what Judge Cannon has done is hand Trump a political cudgel at this extraordinary moment in his presidential campaign, right as he's getting the nomination.
sentences.zh: 所以坎农法官所做的是，在特朗普总统竞选的关键时刻，就在他获得提名的那一刻，递给了他一根政治大棒，对吧？

sentences.en: And that allows him to kind of push back against one of the central arguments that the Biden campaign has made against him,
sentences.zh: 这使他能够反击拜登竞选团队针对他提出的核心论点之一，

sentences.en: which is that he is a convicted felon with four criminal cases brought against him.
sentences.zh: 即他是一个被定罪的重罪犯，面临四起刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: And, you know, Trump now gets to point to a federal judge's ruling that ratifies his own narrative.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，特朗普现在可以引用一位联邦法官的裁决来证实他自己的叙事。

sentences.en: So whether she meant to or not, what Judge Cannon has essentially given Trump is a way to say, hey, you don't have to believe me, believe her.
sentences.zh: 所以，无论她是否有意为之，坎农法官本质上给了特朗普一种说法，即：嘿，你不必相信我，相信她吧。

sentences.en: The witch hunt is real.
sentences.zh: 这场政治迫害是真的。

sentences.en: Alan, thank you.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，谢谢你。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的消息。

sentences.en: A jury in New York found Senator Robert Menendez, a Democrat of New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 纽约的一个陪审团裁定新泽西州民主党参议员罗伯特·梅嫩德斯，

sentences.en: guilty on all counts in a sweeping scheme to sell his office to foreign powers and corrupt businessmen in exchange for hundreds of thousands of dollars in cash,
sentences.zh: 在涉及出卖公职以换取数十万美元现金、豪华轿车和金条的广泛计划中，所有指控罪名成立，

sentences.en: a luxury car and bars of gold.
sentences.zh: 这些贿赂来自外国势力和腐败商人。

sentences.en: I have never been anything but a patriot of my country and for my country.
sentences.zh: 我一直都是我国家的爱国者，也一直为了我的国家服务。

sentences.en: I have never, ever been a foreign agent.
sentences.zh: 我从来、从来没有做过外国代理人。

sentences.en: Speaking after the verdict, Menendez remained defiant and vowed to appeal.
sentences.zh: 在判决后发表讲话时，梅嫩德斯表现得依然强硬，并誓言要上诉。

sentences.en: Menendez is the first U.S.
sentences.zh: 梅嫩德斯是第一位被判犯有充当外国代理人罪的美国参议员。

sentences.en: senator to be convicted of acting as a foreign agent.
sentences.zh: 他现在面临可能长达数十年的监禁。

sentences.en: He now faces potentially decades in prison.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在华盛顿，参议院多数党领袖查克·舒默呼吁任期将于年底结束的梅嫩德斯立即辞职。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, in Washington, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer called on Menendez, whose term expires at the end of the year, to resign immediately.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州民主党州长菲尔·墨菲表示，如果梅嫩德斯辞职，他将任命一名临时人选来填补该席位。

sentences.en: New Jersey's Democratic governor, Phil Murphy, said that if Menendez stepped down, he would make a temporary appointment to fill the seat.

sentences.zh: 包含罗文·内米斯托、丹·鲍威尔、艾丽西亚·拜图和黛安·黄的原创音乐，并由艾丽莎·莫克斯利进行工程制作。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？
